Payment idempotency, gateway sandbox adapter, returns, and finance refund authorization.

Summary: Role-based login and scoped session management
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid credentials, issue role-scoped JWT token. Reject invalid credentials with 401; block unauthorized role routes with 403.

Summary: Atomic stock reservation with TTL expiry
Acceptance Criteria: Reserve available inventory atomically with 15-minute TTL. Reject out-of-stock orders with zero negative stock. Auto-release expired reservations.

Summary: Idempotent payment processing with local stub
Acceptance Criteria: Submit payment with idempotency key. Ten retries yield exactly one charge. Network timeout leaves order in recoverable state.
Connect payment adapter to external vendor sandbox. Map success, decline, and timeout responses. Secrets kept strictly server-side.
Display only reserved and paid items for assigned warehouse. Exclude unpaid, cancelled, or out-of-stock orders.
Enforce valid state transitions (PAID -> PICKING -> PICKED -> DISPATCHED -> DELIVERED). Reject invalid jumps. Log immutable audit trail.
Render visual tracking timeline (Paid, Picked, Dispatched, Delivered). Full keyboard navigation (WCAG AA). Mask internal notes.
Allow return submission for delivered orders within 14-day window. Reject requests for non-delivered or expired orders.
Only FINANCE_REVIEWER can approve refunds. Support agent attempts return 403. Audit approver ID, timestamp, and transaction ID.

Summary: Local build and smoke test automation
Acceptance Criteria: Clean checkout builds and executes automated test suite with single command (python -m unittest discover) passing 100%.
Pull requests trigger automated unit/integration test suite. Failed tests prevent merge to main branch.
Support agent can search orders by ID/email to inspect timeline, courier link, and return progress without write permissions.
Raise single deterministic notification when available inventory falls below safety threshold (<= 3 units). Prevent duplicate spam.
Barcode scan confirms correct item against pick list. Reject mismatched barcodes with audible/visual alert.
Executive summary reconciles gross sales against completed order records. Strictly deferred post-festival release.
